#!/bin/bash
# Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start.
# Runs Hub.exe under Wine and streams its log to stdout for the AMP console.
# Hub is started with -outputDir server-logs/ (inside the AMP file manager root) and passes it on to every service
# and battle server, so all game logs and crash dumps land there; Hub writes a dated hub_YYYY_MM_DD.log in its logs/.
# Logins and logouts are only in the shard log, so that is followed too and turned into
# "[AMP] Player joined/left" lines for AMP's user tracking. Once a minute an "[AMP] Stats:" line feeds AMP's metrics:
# registered accounts (from MongoDB) and the whole server's CPU and memory (from the container's cgroup).
# Start order: MongoDB, then Hub. Stop order (on SIGTERM from AMP): Hub, then every other game process (services and
# battle servers shut themselves down once Hub is gone; stragglers are killed after 30s), then MongoDB, so nothing is
# still writing when the database stops. A stopped instance never has a running database, so AMP backups of
# database/data are consistent. App.ExitTimeout (120s) covers the whole sequence.
OUTDIR='{{$FullBaseDir}}server/server-logs'
LOGDIR="$OUTDIR/logs"
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
# resolve NAME: today's log for NAME (a glob: the shard log is prefixed with its cloud address)
resolve() { local g=( $LOGDIR/$1_$(date +%Y_%m_%d).log ); echo "${g[0]}"; }
size() { stat -c %s "$1" 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
# follow NAME OFFSET: stream the log from OFFSET, waiting for it to appear and switching files at midnight
follow() {
  local name=$1 off=$2 f t
  f=$(resolve "$name")
  while kill -0 $HUB 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then sleep 2; f=$(resolve "$name"); continue; fi
    tail -c +$off -F "$f" 2>/dev/null &
    t=$!
    while kill -0 $HUB 2>/dev/null && [ "$(resolve "$name")" = "$f" ]; do sleep 5; done
    sleep 2
    kill $t 2>/dev/null
    f=$(resolve "$name")
    off=1
  done
}
# players: shard log lines in, "[AMP] Player joined/left" lines out
players() {
  declare -A NICK ONLINE
  local line uid nick
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    case "$line" in
      *"Granting authorization ( uid "*", nick: '"*)
        uid=${line#*( uid }; uid=${uid%% *}
        nick=${line#*nick: \'}; nick=${nick%\' )*}
        NICK[$uid]=$nick ;;
      *"SessionManager::AcceptClientOnChannel, at "*" logged in as "*)
        uid=${line##* logged in as }
        if [ -z "${ONLINE[$uid]}" ]; then
          ONLINE[$uid]=1
          echo "[AMP] Player joined: ${NICK[$uid]:-uid$uid} (uid $uid)"
          echo "[AMP] Players online: ${#ONLINE[@]}"
        fi ;;
      *"SessionManager::OnDisconnect, uid: "*)
        uid=${line#*uid: }; uid=${uid%% *}
        if [ -n "${ONLINE[$uid]}" ]; then
          unset "ONLINE[$uid]"
          echo "[AMP] Player left: ${NICK[$uid]:-uid$uid} (uid $uid)"
          echo "[AMP] Players online: ${#ONLINE[@]}"
        fi ;;
    esac
  done
}
# game_procs: the Windows programs still running in this Wine prefix, without Wine's own helper processes
game_procs() {
  ps -eo args | grep -o '^[^ ]*\.exe' | sed 's/.*[\\/]//' | grep -viE '^(services|winedevice|plugplay|explorer|rpcss|svchost|conhost|start|wineboot|tabtip|rundll32)\.exe$'
}
# kill_tree PID: PID and everything it started, children first
kill_tree() {
  local c
  for c in $(pgrep -P "$1"); do kill_tree "$c"; done
  kill "$1" 2>/dev/null
}
# Whole-server usage for the Server CPU / Server Memory metrics. AMP's own CPU and memory tiles follow a single
# process (this script), so the totals come from the container's cgroup, which holds every process of the instance:
# Hub, services, battle servers, MongoDB. Memory is counted like docker stats: memory.current minus inactive_file.
CG=/sys/fs/cgroup
CGP=$(sed -n 's/^0:://p' /proc/self/cgroup 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$CGP" ] && [ -f "$CG$CGP/cpu.stat" ] && CG=$CG$CGP
NCPU=$(nproc 2>/dev/null || echo 1)
HZ=$(getconf CLK_TCK 2>/dev/null || echo 100)
# limit_mb: the container's memory limit (AMP's memory limit for the instance), or the host's RAM without one, in MB
limit_mb() {
  local l
  l=$(cat "$CG/memory.max" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$l" in ''|max) l=$(awk '/^MemTotal:/ { print $2 * 1024 }' /proc/meminfo) ;; esac
  echo $(( l / 1048576 ))
}
# usage: "<CPU time used so far, in microseconds> <memory in use, in bytes>" for the whole container
usage() {
  if [ -f "$CG/cpu.stat" ] && [ -f "$CG/memory.current" ]; then
    local u m i
    u=$(awk '$1 == "usage_usec" { print $2 }' "$CG/cpu.stat")
    m=$(cat "$CG/memory.current")
    i=$(awk '$1 == "inactive_file" { print $2 }' "$CG/memory.stat" 2>/dev/null)
    echo "${u:-0} $(( m - ${i:-0} ))"
  else
    # No cgroup v2 files: add up the processes instead (only this container's are visible here).
    local t r
    t=$(cat /proc/[0-9]*/stat 2>/dev/null | awk '{ sub(/^.*\) /, ""); t += $12 + $13 } END { printf "%d", t }')
    r=$(ps -eo rss= | awk '{ s += $1 } END { printf "%d", s }')
    echo "$(( t * 1000000 / HZ )) $(( r * 1024 ))"
  fi
}
# stats: every minute one line for AMP's metrics: registered accounts (queried every 5 minutes; the db name gets the
# Windows user as suffix), CPU in % of all cores over the last minute, and memory in MB
stats() {
  local host='127.0.0.1:{{$MongoPort}}' acc='' n u m t cpu i=0 pu pt primed=''
  if [ '{{MongoMode}}' = external ]; then
    host='{{MongoHosts}}'; host=${host%%;*}; host=${host%%|*}; host=${host%%,*}; host=${host// /}
  fi
  [ -f "$CG/cpu.stat" ] || echo '[AMP] Note: container cgroup not found, Server CPU and Server Memory are summed over processes'
  read -r pu m <<< "$(usage)"; pt=$(date +%s%N)
  sleep 60
  while kill -0 $HUB 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ $(( i % 5 )) -eq 0 ]; then
      n=$('{{$FullBaseDir}}database/mongodb/bin/mongo' --quiet "$host/cosmosim_$(id -un)" --eval 'db.getMongo().setSlaveOk(); print(db.accounts.count())' 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '0-9')
      [ -n "$n" ] && acc=$n
    fi
    i=$(( i + 1 ))
    read -r u m <<< "$(usage)"; t=$(date +%s%N)
    cpu=$(awk -v u="$u" -v pu="$pu" -v t="$t" -v pt="$pt" -v n="$NCPU" 'BEGIN { d = (u - pu) / ((t - pt) / 1000) / n * 100; if (d < 0) d = 0; printf "%.1f", d }')
    pu=$u; pt=$t
    if [ -n "$acc" ]; then
      # AMP scales custom metrics to the highest value it has seen. One reading at 100% CPU and at the memory limit
      # sets the scales to those; the real reading follows straight away.
      [ -n "$primed" ] || { echo "[AMP] Stats: accounts $acc, cpu 100.0%, memory $(limit_mb) MB"; primed=1; }
      echo "[AMP] Stats: accounts $acc, cpu $cpu%, memory $(( m / 1048576 )) MB"
    fi
    sleep 60
  done
}

MONGO=''
[ '{{MongoMode}}' = external ] || MONGO='{{$FullRootDir}}mongodb.sh'
[ -z "$MONGO" ] || /bin/bash "$MONGO" start || exit 1

# Offsets are taken before Hub starts, so nothing it writes is missed and earlier runs are not replayed.
HUB_OFF=$(( $(size "$(resolve hub)") + 1 ))
SHARD_OFF=$(( $(size "$(resolve '*_shard')") + 1 ))
/usr/bin/wine Hub.exe -outputDir "Z:$OUTDIR" &
HUB=$!
trap 'kill -TERM $HUB 2>/dev/null' TERM INT
follow hub $HUB_OFF | sed -u 's/\r$//' &
follow '*_shard' $SHARD_OFF | sed -u 's/\r$//' | players &
stats &
wait $HUB
RC=$?
while kill -0 $HUB 2>/dev/null; do wait $HUB; RC=$?; done
echo "[AMP] Stopping: Hub exited ($RC)"
WINESERVER="$(dirname "$(readlink -f /usr/bin/wine)")/wineserver"
LEFT=$(game_procs)
if [ -n "$LEFT" ]; then
  echo "[AMP] Stopping: waiting for $(echo "$LEFT" | wc -l) game processes: $(echo $LEFT)"
  if ! timeout 30 "$WINESERVER" -w; then
    echo "[AMP] Stopping: WARNING: still running after 30s, killing: $(echo $(game_procs))"
    "$WINESERVER" -k
    timeout 10 "$WINESERVER" -w
  fi
fi
[ -z "$MONGO" ] || /bin/bash "$MONGO" stop
# The log followers (tail -F, sed, players) and the stats loop hold this script's stdout open, and AMP waits for
# stdout to close before it considers the application stopped, so all of them go, including grandchildren.
for c in $(pgrep -P $$); do kill_tree "$c"; done
echo '[AMP] Stopped'
exit $RC

// Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start. Put your own overrides in common_local.cfg.
set lb_listenTo "{{$LoadBalancerPort}}"
set net_overrideShardAddr "{{PublicAddress}}"
set net_overrideChatServerAddr "{{PublicAddress}}"

// Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start. Put your own overrides in common_local.cfg.
set chat_server_port "{{$ChatPort}}"

// Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start. Put your own overrides in common_local.cfg.
set net_gamePort "{{$BattlePort}}"

// Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start. Put your own overrides in common_local.cfg.
// Reward settings now live in the AMP block of default_platform_config.lua, which overrides this file.

#!/bin/bash
# Managed by AMP - regenerated on every start.
# Writes the AMP settings into cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua. ConfigServer pushes that file to
# every service after it has read its .cfg files, so values set there win over *_local.cfg.
# Only values that differ from vanilla are written, as a marked block appended to the file; with every
# setting at vanilla there is no block and the file is byte-identical to the original.
F='{{$FullBaseDir}}server/cloud/data/default_platform_config.lua'
BEGIN='-- >>> AMP managed settings'
END='-- <<< AMP managed settings'
[ -f "$F" ] || { echo "AMP settings: $F not found"; exit 1; }
sed -i "/^$BEGIN/,/^$END/d" "$F"

# External MongoDB: every service and battle server execs common.cfg -> common_local.cfg before it connects to
# the database, so db_mongoHosts goes there, in a marked block; the rest of that file stays the user's.
C='{{$FullBaseDir}}server/cloud/data/common_local.cfg'
[ -f "$C" ] && sed -i '/^\/\/ >>> AMP managed/,/^\/\/ <<< AMP managed/d' "$C"
if [ '{{MongoMode}}' = external ]; then
  [ -n '{{MongoHosts}}' ] || { echo 'AMP settings: MongoDB is set to External but External MongoDB Hosts is empty. Aborting'; exit 1; }
  printf '// >>> AMP managed (rewritten on every start; put your own settings outside this block)\nset db_mongoHosts "%s"\n// <<< AMP managed\n' '{{MongoHosts}}' >> "$C"
  echo 'AMP settings: using external MongoDB {{MongoHosts}}'
elif [ '{{$MongoPort}}' != 27017 ]; then
  # Bundled MongoDB on this instance's own port (so several instances can share one host).
  printf '// >>> AMP managed (rewritten on every start; put your own settings outside this block)\nset db_mongoHosts "127.0.0.1:%s"\n// <<< AMP managed\n' '{{$MongoPort}}' >> "$C"
fi

# Battle pass: the start/stage locals at the top of the file feed Shard_ and QuestServer_SetupBattlePassActivation,
# which run before the AMP block, so they are edited in place. Disabled writes back the vanilla (expired 2023) values.
BP_START='2023-06-09T05:00:00Z'
BP_TABLE='{ {1,"2023-09-14T00:00:00Z"}, {2,"2023-09-14T00:00:00Z"}, {3,"2023-09-14T00:00:00Z"}}'
BP_UNLOCK='2023-07-14T00:00:00Z'
# Dates are accepted in any format GNU date understands (AMP stores them as e.g. "10/13/2026 00:00:00")
# and are taken as UTC. The game needs YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
utc() { [ -z "$1" ] && return 0; date -u -d "$1" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ 2>/dev/null; }
if [ '{{BattlePassEnabled}}' = true ]; then
  if ! S=$(utc '{{BattlePassStart}}') || [ -z "$S" ]; then
    echo "AMP settings: Battle Pass Start '{{BattlePassStart}}' is not a date, battle pass left disabled"
  elif ! E=$(utc '{{BattlePassEnd}}'); then
    echo "AMP settings: Battle Pass End '{{BattlePassEnd}}' is not a date, battle pass left disabled"
  else
    BP_START=$S
    BP_TABLE="{ {1,\"$E\"}}"
    BP_UNLOCK=$S
    if [ -n "$E" ]; then echo "AMP settings: battle pass active from $S until $E"
    else echo "AMP settings: battle pass active from $S with no end"; fi
  fi
fi
sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*local battlePassStart[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*)\"[^\"]*\"/\1\"$BP_START\"/; s/^([[:space:]]*local battlePassEndTable[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*)\{.*\}( --)/\1$BP_TABLE\2/; s/^([[:space:]]*cvars\.store_battlePassUnlockLvlBtnStart[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*)\"[^\"]*\"/\1\"$BP_UNLOCK\"/" "$F"

# Arena bots: both arcade queue templates also get the bot count in their own "special" table (as SCPatcher's
# "Full arena matches" does), edited in place; 6 (vanilla) writes back the original "special = { arcade = 1 }".
BOTS=''
awk -v a='{{ArenaBotsCount}}' 'BEGIN { exit !(a == 6) }' || BOTS=', botsCount = {{ArenaBotsCount}}'
sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*special = \{ arcade = 1)(, botsCount = [0-9]+)?( \},)/\1$BOTS\3/" "$F"

# DLC packs in the shop (experimental): the Bundle_Arc_DLC_* bundles have GS prices but are hiddenInShop in the
# client's defs; the client still shows a bundle whose store item carries the IS_SHOW flag, and the server reads
# a flags attribute per item from store.xml. The bit values are not known, so all four flags are set (15).
# Off removes the attribute again (vanilla store.xml has none).
S='{{$FullBaseDir}}server/cloud/data/store.xml'
if [ -f "$S" ]; then
  if [ '{{DlcPacksInShop}}' = true ]; then
    sed -i -E '/defName="Bundle_Arc_DLC_/{s/ flags="[0-9]+"//; s/^([[:space:]]*<Item id="[0-9]+")/\1 flags="15"/}' "$S"
    echo "AMP settings: DLC packs shown in the shop ($(grep -c '<Item id=.*defName="Bundle_Arc_DLC_' "$S") packs)"
  else
    sed -i -E '/defName="Bundle_Arc_DLC_/s/ flags="[0-9]+"//' "$S"
  fi
fi

# Destroyer pack items in the shop (experimental): the unique weapons and modules that came with the former destroyer
# packs (Vigilant, Tyrant, Emperor, Albireo) have GS prices in store.xml but are cantBeBought. On removes that flag
# from their Mk1 items; they can still only be fitted to their destroyer (required_ship). Off puts the flag back
# exactly where vanilla store.xml has it, right after defName.
DESTROYER_ITEMS='Weapon_DestrResonatingLaser_T5_Mk1 Weapon_KineticFloatingCrit_T5_Mk1 Module_IsotopeHarvester_T5_Mk1 Module_ShieldHealOnEnemyDeath_T5_Mk1 Weapon_OmegaB_T5_Mk1 Module_EmperorsRobe_T5_Mk1 Weapon_PlasmaWebLaser_T5_Mk1 Module_DroneField_T5_Mk1'
if [ -f "$S" ]; then
  for d in $DESTROYER_ITEMS; do
    if [ '{{DestroyerPackItemsInShop}}' = true ]; then
      sed -i -E "/<Item [^>]*defName=\"$d\"/s/ cantBeBought=\"1\"//" "$S"
    else
      sed -i -E "/<Item [^>]*defName=\"$d\"/{/cantBeBought=/!s/(defName=\"$d\")/\\1 cantBeBought=\"1\"/}" "$S"
    fi
  done
  [ '{{DestroyerPackItemsInShop}}' = true ] && echo "AMP settings: destroyer pack items buyable ($(for d in $DESTROYER_ITEMS; do grep "<Item [^>]*defName=\"$d\"" "$S"; done | grep -vc cantBeBought) of 8)"
fi

# DLC extras in the shop (experimental): the cosmetic former DLC bundles (70 pilot portraits, the ship titles and
# taunts of the *_Stuff packs, Pikabu) are hidden in the client, cantBeBought and priced 99999999 GS in store.xml.
# A price above 0 shows them (IS_SHOW, flags=15 as for the DLC packs), unblocks them and sets that GS price.
# 0 restores the vanilla lines exactly. One sed run with an address block per bundle.
DLC_EXTRAS='
  Bundle_Avatar_117 Bundle_Avatar_120 Bundle_Avatar_133 Bundle_Avatar_134 Bundle_Avatar_135 Bundle_Avatar_150
  Bundle_Avatar_151 Bundle_Avatar_152 Bundle_Avatar_157 Bundle_Avatar_158 Bundle_Avatar_165 Bundle_Avatar_171
  Bundle_Avatar_173 Bundle_Avatar_174 Bundle_Avatar_176 Bundle_Avatar_177 Bundle_Avatar_178 Bundle_Avatar_179
  Bundle_Avatar_180 Bundle_Avatar_181 Bundle_Avatar_183 Bundle_Avatar_184 Bundle_Avatar_185 Bundle_Avatar_195
  Bundle_Avatar_196 Bundle_Avatar_198 Bundle_Avatar_200 Bundle_Avatar_209 Bundle_Avatar_210 Bundle_Avatar_216
  Bundle_Avatar_217 Bundle_Avatar_223 Bundle_Avatar_229 Bundle_Avatar_230 Bundle_Avatar_231 Bundle_Avatar_237
  Bundle_Avatar_238 Bundle_Avatar_239 Bundle_Avatar_249 Bundle_Avatar_254 Bundle_Avatar_255 Bundle_Avatar_256
  Bundle_Avatar_261 Bundle_Avatar_262 Bundle_Avatar_263 Bundle_Avatar_268 Bundle_Avatar_273 Bundle_Avatar_278
  Bundle_Avatar_279 Bundle_Avatar_280 Bundle_Avatar_286 Bundle_Avatar_291 Bundle_Avatar_292 Bundle_Avatar_297
  Bundle_Avatar_298 Bundle_Avatar_307 Bundle_Avatar_308 Bundle_Avatar_317 Bundle_Avatar_322 Bundle_Avatar_327
  Bundle_Avatar_328 Bundle_Avatar_337 Bundle_Avatar_338 Bundle_Avatar_347 Bundle_Avatar_352 Bundle_Avatar_357
  Bundle_Avatar_362 Bundle_Avatar_363 Bundle_Avatar_372 Bundle_Avatar_373 Bundle_Caltrop_Stuff
  Bundle_Confessor_Stuff Bundle_Cyning_Stuff Bundle_DragonflyStuff Bundle_Jaguar_Stuff Bundle_Kraken_Stuff
  Bundle_Mjolnir_Stuff Bundle_Octopus_Stuff Bundle_Peregrine_Stuff Bundle_Pikabu Bundle_Ronin_Stuff
  Bundle_Saw_One_Stuff Bundle_Wasp_Stuff'
P='{{DlcExtrasPrice}}'; P=${P%%.*}; case "$P" in ''|*[!0-9]*) P=0 ;; esac
if [ -f "$S" ]; then
  SED=$(mktemp)
  for b in $DLC_EXTRAS; do
    if [ "$P" -gt 0 ]; then
      echo "/<Item [^>]*defName=\"$b\"/{s/ flags=\"[0-9]+\"//; s/^([[:space:]]*<Item id=\"[0-9]+\")/\\1 flags=\"15\"/; s/ premiumPrice=\"[0-9]+\"/ premiumPrice=\"$P\"/; s/ basePremiumPrice=\"[0-9]+\"/ basePremiumPrice=\"$P\"/; s/ cantBeBought=\"1\"//}"
    else
      echo "/<Item [^>]*defName=\"$b\"/{s/ flags=\"[0-9]+\"//; s/ premiumPrice=\"[0-9]+\"/ premiumPrice=\"99999999\"/; s/ basePremiumPrice=\"[0-9]+\"/ basePremiumPrice=\"99999999\"/; /cantBeBought=/!s/(defName=\"$b\")/\\1 cantBeBought=\"1\"/}"
    fi
  done > "$SED"
  sed -i -E -f "$SED" "$S"
  rm -f "$SED"
  [ "$P" -gt 0 ] && echo "AMP settings: DLC extras in the shop for $P GS each ($(for b in $DLC_EXTRAS; do grep "<Item [^>]*defName=\"$b\"" "$S"; done | grep -c "flags=\"15\".*premiumPrice=\"$P\"") of $(echo $DLC_EXTRAS | wc -w) bundles)"
fi

# Coop vs AI team size (experimental): the battle gets botsCount (all bots) and botsInTeam1 (bots on the players'
# team) as parameters; both coop templates and the newbie coop queue get them in their special table, sized for
# one player: N-1 allies and N enemies. 0 (vanilla) writes back the original "coop_vs_ai = 1 }".
COOP=''
N='{{CoopTeamSize}}'
if awk -v n="$N" 'BEGIN { exit !(n >= 2) }'; then
  N=${N%%.*}
  COOP=", botsCount = $(( 2 * N - 1 )), botsInTeam1 = $(( N - 1 ))"
  echo "AMP settings: coop vs AI sized for ${N}v${N} (botsCount $(( 2 * N - 1 )), botsInTeam1 $(( N - 1 )))"
fi
sed -i -E "s/(coop_vs_ai = 1)(, botsCount = [0-9]+, botsInTeam1 = [0-9]+)?( \})/\1$COOP\3/" "$F"

declare -A BLOCK
SERVICES=()
same() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { exit !(a == b) }'; }
emit() { # service cvar lua-value
  [ -n "${BLOCK[$1]+x}" ] || SERVICES+=("$1")
  BLOCK[$1]+="	cvars.$2 = $3"$'\r\n'
}
num() { # service cvar value vanilla
  same "$3" "$4" || emit "$1" "$2" "$3"
}
str() { # service cvar value vanilla
  [ "$3" = "$4" ] || emit "$1" "$2" "\"$3\""
}
rank_list() { # service cvar multiplier : the same multiplier for all 18 ranks, vanilla 1
  same "$3" 1 || emit "$1" "$2" "\"$(for i in $(seq 18); do printf '%s,' "$3"; done | sed 's/,$//')\""
}

# Accounts
num ST_SHARD credits_on_start '{{NewAccountCredits}}' 0
num ST_SHARD gold_on_start '{{StartingGold}}' 300
# premium_on_start is in hours (the game multiplies by 3600 into 32 bits, so it is capped at 20000 days)
num ST_SHARD premium_on_start "$(awk -v d='{{StartingPremiumDays}}' 'BEGIN { if (d > 20000) d = 20000; printf "%d", d * 24 }')" 0
num ST_SHARD premiumTimeForAccountRank "$(awk -v h='{{PremiumHoursPerRank}}' 'BEGIN { printf "%d", h * 3600 }')" 86400
[ '{{InfinitePremium}}' = true ] && str ST_SHARD auth_infinitePremiumForRoles 'gm;support;player' 'gm;support'
# Economy
rank_list ST_MATCHMAKER rate_exp '{{XpMultiplier}}'
rank_list ST_ZONE_INSTANCE sv_expRate '{{XpMultiplier}}'
rank_list ST_MATCHMAKER rate_cred '{{CreditMultiplier}}'
for svc in ST_DEDICATED_SERVER ST_ZONE_INSTANCE; do
  for mode in Pve Pvp Coop Brawl; do num $svc sv_dailyWin${mode}ExpRewardCf '{{FirstWinXpMultiplier}}' 3; done
done
num ST_GAME_REWARD_DISPENCER reward_bonusGoldForWinner '{{BonusGoldWinner}}' 0
num ST_GAME_REWARD_DISPENCER reward_bonusGoldForLooser '{{BonusGoldLoser}}' 0
num ST_SHARD sv_tokenCreditsDailyLimit '{{TokenDailyLimit}}' 1000
num ST_GAME_REWARD_DISPENCER sv_tokenCreditsDailyLimit '{{TokenDailyLimit}}' 1000
num ST_SHARD store_vesselPriceMod '{{ShipPriceMultiplier}}' 1
num ST_SHARD store_modulePriceMod '{{ModulePriceMultiplier}}' 1
num ST_SHARD store_munitionPriceMod '{{AmmoPriceMultiplier}}' 1
# Battles and open space
num ST_DEDICATED_SERVER sv_afkCheckDuration '{{AfkKickSeconds}}' 120
num ST_ZONE_INSTANCE sv_resurrectionCreditsPrice '{{ResurrectionCost}}' 100000
# Server
num ST_LOAD_BALANCER lb_limitPlayersOnShardTo '{{$MaxUsers}}' 800

if [ ${#SERVICES[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'AMP settings: block settings all vanilla, no AMP block written'
  exit 0
fi
{
  printf '%s (rewritten by AMP on every start)\r\n' "$BEGIN"
  for svc in "${SERVICES[@]}"; do
    printf 'if( service_type == "%s" ) then\r\n%send\r\n' "$svc" "${BLOCK[$svc]}"
  done
  printf '%s\r\n' "$END"
} >> "$F"
echo "AMP settings written to default_platform_config.lua:"

#!/bin/bash
# Managed by AMP - regenerated on every update and start.
# The bundled MongoDB: MongoDB 3.4 for Linux, run natively (no Wine), everything in instance/database/:
#   database/mongodb/  binaries        database/data/  data (WiredTiger)        database/mongod.log
# 3.4 is the newest MongoDB the game's database driver works with (see the README).
#   install <version> <sha256>  update stage: downloads MongoDB's generic Linux build, unless that version is installed
#   prepare   start stage: stops a MongoDB left running, migrates old MongoDB 2.6 data once, restarts the Wine server
#   start     hub-wrapper.sh, before Hub: starts MongoDB and waits until it accepts connections
#   stop      hub-wrapper.sh, after Hub: shuts MongoDB down cleanly
#   external  start stage: waits for External MongoDB Hosts
ROOT='{{$FullRootDir}}'
BASE='{{$FullBaseDir}}'
DB="${BASE}database"
BIN="$DB/mongodb/bin"
DATA="$DB/data"
PID="$DB/mongod.pid"
PORT='{{$MongoPort}}'
export WINEPREFIX="${ROOT}.wine" WINEARCH=win64 WINEDEBUG=-all WINEDLLOVERRIDES='mscoree,mshtml='
WINESERVER="$(dirname "$(readlink -f /usr/bin/wine)")/wineserver"

port_open() { (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null; }
free_port() { local p=$1; while port_open "$p"; do p=$((p + 1)); done; echo "$p"; }
running() { [ -s "$PID" ] && ps -p "$(cat "$PID")" -o args= 2>/dev/null | grep -q '[m]ongod '; }
wine_mongod_running() { ps -eo args | grep -q '^[^ ]*[m]ongod\.exe'; }
empty_data() { rm -rf "${DATA:?}" && mkdir -p "$DATA"; }

stop_mongod() {
  running || { rm -f "$PID"; return 0; }
  echo 'Stopping MongoDB'
  kill -TERM "$(cat "$PID")"
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do running || { rm -f "$PID"; return 0; }; sleep 1; done
  echo 'WARNING: MongoDB did not stop within 60s'
  return 1
}

start_mongod() {
  [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] || { echo "MongoDB is not installed in $DB/mongodb: update the instance. Aborting"; return 1; }
  running && { echo 'MongoDB is already running'; return 0; }
  port_open "$PORT" && { echo "Port $PORT (MongoDB Port) is already in use by something else. Aborting"; return 1; }
  mkdir -p "$DATA"
  "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB '{{MongoCacheSizeGB}}' \
    --logpath "$DB/mongod.log" --logappend --pidfilepath "$PID" --fork >/dev/null \
    || { tail -n 5 "$DB/mongod.log"; echo 'MongoDB did not start, see database/mongod.log. Aborting'; return 1; }
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do port_open "$PORT" && { echo "MongoDB is up on 127.0.0.1:$PORT"; return 0; }; sleep 1; done
  echo 'MongoDB did not accept connections within 60s, see database/mongod.log. Aborting'
  return 1
}

# Template versions before 2.0 ran the MongoDB 2.6 that ships with the server under Wine, with its data in
# server/mongo-data (before 1.12: star-conflict/mongo-data). That data is copied into database/data once, here: the old
# mongod.exe serves it on a spare port, and the 3.4 tools dump it into a temporary 3.4 on another one.
# database/data/.migrated records it. The old folder is left as it is.
migrate() {
  local old='' d
  for d in "${BASE}server/mongo-data" "${ROOT}mongo-data"; do
    ls "$d"/*.ns >/dev/null 2>&1 && { old=$d; break; }
  done
  [ -n "$old" ] || return 0
  [ -e "$DATA/.migrated" ] && return 0
  if [ -n "$(ls -A "$DATA" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "Note: $old holds MongoDB 2.6 data that was not migrated, because database/data already has data"
    return 0
  fi
  [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] || { echo "MongoDB is not installed in $DB/mongodb: update the instance. Aborting"; return 1; }
  local m26="${BASE}server/cloud/mongodb"
  [ -f "$m26/mongod.exe" ] || { echo "$old needs MongoDB 2.6 to be read, but server/cloud/mongodb/mongod.exe is missing. Aborting"; return 1; }
  echo "Migrating the MongoDB 2.6 data in $old to MongoDB 3.4 in database/data (once; the old folder stays as it is)"
  # A non-empty lock with no journal files is left by a clean shutdown that was cut off after its final commit.
  if [ -s "$old/mongod.lock" ] && ! ls "$old"/journal/j._* >/dev/null 2>&1; then : > "$old/mongod.lock"; fi
  local src dst log="$DB/migrate.log" status dbs ok=1
  src=$(free_port 27100)
  (cd "$m26" && exec /usr/bin/wine mongod.exe --dbpath "Z:$old" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$src" --smallfiles --logpath "Z:$old/mongod.log" --logappend) >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  for i in $(seq 1 90); do port_open "$src" && break; sleep 1; done
  if ! port_open "$src"; then
    echo "MongoDB 2.6 did not start on the old data, see $old/mongod.log. Aborting"
    "$WINESERVER" -k 2>/dev/null
    return 1
  fi
  dst=$(free_port $((src + 1)))
  mkdir -p "$DATA"
  : > "$log"
  if "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --bind_ip 127.0.0.1 --port "$dst" --wiredTigerCacheSizeGB 0.25 --logpath "$DB/migrate-mongod.log" --fork >/dev/null; then
    # admin holds 2.6's users and auth schema, which the game doesn't use.
    "$BIN/mongodump" --host "127.0.0.1:$src" --archive 2>>"$log" | "$BIN/mongorestore" --host "127.0.0.1:$dst" --archive --nsExclude 'admin.*' 2>>"$log"
    status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
    dbs=$("$BIN/mongo" --port "$dst" --quiet --eval 'db.adminCommand("listDatabases").databases.forEach(function (d) { if (d.name != "admin" && d.name != "local") print(d.name); })' 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ')
    [ "${status[0]}" -eq 0 ] && [ "${status[1]}" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$dbs" ] && ok=0
    "$BIN/mongod" --dbpath "$DATA" --shutdown >/dev/null
  else
    echo 'Temporary MongoDB 3.4 did not start, see database/migrate-mongod.log' >>"$log"
  fi
  "$BIN/mongo" --port "$src" --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB('admin').shutdownServer()" >/dev/null 2>&1
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do wine_mongod_running || break; sleep 1; done
  if [ $ok -ne 0 ]; then
    tail -n 20 "$log"
    echo 'Migrating the MongoDB data failed (full output in database/migrate.log). database/data was emptied again; the old data is untouched. Aborting'
    empty_data
    return 1
  fi
  echo "$old on $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC'): $dbs" > "$DATA/.migrated"
  echo "Migrated: $dbs"
  echo "Once the server runs fine, $old can be deleted"
}

case "$1" in
  install)
    version=$2 sha=$3
    mkdir -p "$DATA"
    if [ -x "$BIN/mongod" ] && "$BIN/mongod" --version | grep -q "^db version v$version\$"; then
      echo "MongoDB $version is already installed"; exit 0
    fi
    tgz="$DB/mongodb.tgz"
    echo "Downloading MongoDB $version"
    wget -nv -O "$tgz" "https://fastdl.mongodb.org/linux/mongodb-linux-x86_64-$version.tgz" || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'MongoDB download failed. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    echo "$sha  $tgz" | sha256sum -c --quiet - || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'MongoDB download has the wrong checksum. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    rm -rf "$DB/mongodb" && mkdir -p "$DB/mongodb" && tar -xzf "$tgz" -C "$DB/mongodb" --strip-components=1 || { rm -f "$tgz"; echo 'Extracting MongoDB failed. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    rm -f "$tgz"
    echo "MongoDB $version installed in database/mongodb"
    ;;
  prepare)
    # A MongoDB from a run whose hub-wrapper.sh was killed before it could stop it.
    stop_mongod || exit 1
    # The Wine MongoDB 2.6 of template versions before 2.0, which kept running after Hub stopped.
    if wine_mongod_running; then
      echo 'Stopping the old Wine MongoDB 2.6'
      [ -x "$BIN/mongo" ] && "$BIN/mongo" --port "$PORT" --quiet --eval "db.getSiblingDB('admin').shutdownServer()" >/dev/null 2>&1
      for i in $(seq 1 60); do wine_mongod_running || break; sleep 1; done
    fi
    if [ '{{MongoMode}}' != external ]; then migrate || exit 1; fi
    # Restarting the Wine server clears services and sockets left over from the last run.
    echo 'Restarting the Wine server'
    "$WINESERVER" -k 2>/dev/null
    "$WINESERVER" -w 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  start)
    start_mongod
    ;;
  stop)
    stop_mongod
    ;;
  external)
    # Waits until one host of the first host group in External MongoDB Hosts accepts connections.
    # Format (db_mongoHosts): host1[:port],host2[:port]|options;group2...
    HOSTS='{{MongoHosts}}'
    HOSTS=${HOSTS%%;*}; HOSTS=${HOSTS%%|*}
    [ -n "$HOSTS" ] || { echo 'External MongoDB Hosts is empty. Aborting'; exit 1; }
    IFS=, read -r -a LIST <<< "$HOSTS"
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      for h in "${LIST[@]}"; do
        h=${h// /}; host=${h%:*}; port=${h##*:}; [ "$port" = "$h" ] && port=27017
        if (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/$host/$port") 2>/dev/null; then echo "External MongoDB is up at $host:$port"; exit 0; fi
      done
      sleep 2
    done
    echo "External MongoDB ($HOSTS) did not accept connections within 60s. Aborting"
    exit 1
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 install <version> <sha256> | prepare | start | stop | external"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
